description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility. This is an immediate opening for a visionary leader who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for staff.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and driving continuous quality improvement initiatives. This role offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. Join a team that values your leadership and dedication to resident well-being.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisory role within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine Physician to join a thriving family health services center in Greenville, SC. This role offers a unique opportunity to provide comprehensive medical care within a supportive community environment. We are open to considering candidates for part-time, PRN, or contract positions, with a preference for full-time commitment.

This position comes with a highly competitive compensation package, starting at $210,000 annually, complemented by a robust bonus structure that can reach up to $50,000. This includes a guaranteed bonus of $25,000 and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses, with $9,000 available on the first payday upon signing a promissory note. The role also boasts excellent benefits and generous Paid Time Off (PTO), making it an attractive opportunity for physicians looking for a rewarding career.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board certification or eligibility in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics
Current, unrestricted medical license in the state of South Carolina
Ability to work in a part-time, PRN, or contract capacity
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $210,000 annually, with a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 portion of the bonus is available on the first payday upon signing a promissory note. Total bonus structure can reach up to $50,000.
